headline: US Tort Lawsuit System Costs Reach Over $4,900 Per Household, Study Finds
summary: A new study by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Institute for Legal Reform finds that tort lawsuit system costs now amount to more than $4,900 per American household.
why: High litigation and tort costs act as a hidden tax on corporations, potentially impacting profit margins across multiple consumer and industrial sectors.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Higher systemic legal costs represent an economic burden on households and businesses.
